title: rosa carolina subsp. subserrulata
intro: Rosa carolina subsp. subserrulata, commonly known as the Carolina rose, is a shrub native to the southeastern United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa carolina subsp. subserrulata include soothing wounds, reducing inflammation, and alleviating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
